pages.text: Pipes are for plumbers. My organisms will share their essence the way a body does: through $(l)veins$().$(br2)Lay $(l)Brass Conduit$() from a $(l)Tap$() to wherever the essence should go. The Tap does the rest: every beat it grows the vein one block further along the brass, for a dram of essence.

At the far end, graft a $(l)Maw$() onto another organism of the same essence, facing the vein. Whatever the Tap pushes, the Maw drinks.$(br2)Veins are living tissue, so even $(l)Awareness$() travels through them, which no glass can hold.
pages.title: The Maw
